title: Gunger hates people correcting him

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Hello chief. You ok? You look like you have a lot on your mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello chief. You ok? You look like you have a lot on your mind.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Yeah? Well the main thing ringing in my old brain right now is this Unity Zone. I have a wanderlust, and this lust is going unfulfilled.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah? Well the main thing ringing in my old brain right now is this Unity Zone. I have a wanderlust, and this lust is going unfulfilled.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Anywhere. Pick a direction and go there. That's how my feet work. You think you'll ever get out of here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anywhere. Pick a direction and go there. That's how my feet work. You think you'll ever get out of here?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Damn. I thought someone younger like you would be more... hopeful. You know, I'd love to head out into the wastes one day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Damn. I thought someone younger like you would be more... hopeful. You know, I'd love to head out into the wastes one day.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: The enthusiasm of youth. Love it. Let's hope so. I'd love to head out into the wastes one day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The enthusiasm of youth. Love it. Let's hope so. I'd love to head out into the wastes one day.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: That's what they call it, right? But who says that it's really "wasted"? I mean, you look around here. Doesn't this feel like a wasteland to you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what they call it, right? But who says that it's really "wasted"? I mean, you look around here. Doesn't this feel like a wasteland to you?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I reckon those wastes are a lot less lifeless than the corps tell us. I mean, I don't think it's all green grass and cherry pie, but there's got to be more than radioactive sand and giant rats, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I reckon those wastes are a lot less lifeless than the corps tell us. I mean, I don't think it's all green grass and cherry pie, but there's got to be more than radioactive sand and giant rats, right?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: What would you want that something to be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What would you want that something to be?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: But if there was, what would you want to see?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But if there was, what would you want to see?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Foaming ocean waves and a boat to sail them. What a wonder that would be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Foaming ocean waves and a boat to sail them. What a wonder that would be.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Well, that's not much imagination friend. Or maybe it is. Sometimes it's easier to imagine the end of the universe than an end to... all this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, that's not much imagination friend. Or maybe it is. Sometimes it's easier to imagine the end of the universe than an end to... all this.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: And those little beams of light, thin as a pencil because the trees are so dense. Imagine such a thing!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And those little beams of light, thin as a pencil because the trees are so dense. Imagine such a thing!

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: You're making fun of me? Watch out...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're making fun of me? Watch out...

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Good for you. Good for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good for you. Good for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I... do have a lot on my mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I... do have a lot on my mind.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I... do have a lot on my mind.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I... do have a lot on my mind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where would you go?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where would you go?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think so.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The wastes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The wastes?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sometimes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sometimes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think there's SOMETHING out there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think there's SOMETHING out there.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think there's SOMETHING out there.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think there's SOMETHING out there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think there's nothing out there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think there's nothing out there.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think there's nothing out there.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think there's nothing out there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The sea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The sea.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Another city. A better city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Another city. A better city.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A forest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A forest.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I see wasted people from time to time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see wasted people from time to time.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I see wasted people from time to time.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I see wasted people from time to time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No hard feelings.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No hard feelings.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have a boat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a boat.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Indeed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed.
